name: Start Webserver Authonly Architecture
description: Architecture for the make start-webserver-authonly target, covering the Compose-managed pyweb service, the simple Authorization: XYZ contract, and the CALM CLI config switch used for the local header-protected HTTP stack.

nodes.name: Architect
nodes.description: A human architect or operator who starts the authonly local stack, updates the active CALM CLI config symlink, and requests repository assets through the header-protected Python web server.

nodes.name: Active CALM CLI Config Link
nodes.description: The ~/.calm.json symlink that the startup target rewires so local CALM CLI calls use the authonly configuration.

nodes.name: Authonly CALM CLI Config
nodes.description: The ~/.calmauthonly.json configuration file selected for local development against the authonly repository endpoint.

nodes.name: Simple Authorization Header Contract
nodes.description: The authonly access rule enforced by pyweb, requiring Authorization: XYZ for static GET and HEAD requests while leaving /health reachable without the header.

nodes.name: HTTP Static Content Tree
nodes.description: The static_http content tree mounted directly into the pyweb container so repository architecture files, patterns, standards, controls, and documentation are served from the local repo.

nodes.name: Pyweb Compose Container
nodes.description: A container grouping representing the Compose-managed pyweb runtime that serves local repository assets in authonly mode.

nodes.name: Pyweb Static Server
nodes.description: The apps/pyweb service started by make start-webserver-authonly, serving repository content from static_http over HTTP on 127.0.0.1:8080 with simple header-based protection.

relationships.description: The startup target rewires ~/.calm.json so the active CALM CLI config points at ~/.calmauthonly.json before pyweb is launched.
The pyweb service serves static repository assets from the mounted static_http content tree.
Pyweb enforces the Authorization: XYZ contract for static GET and HEAD requests while preserving unauthenticated access to the /health endpoint.
Architects request protected repository assets from pyweb over HTTP on 127.0.0.1:8080 and include Authorization: XYZ for static content access.
The authonly Compose runtime groups the pyweb static server and the mounted static_http content tree used for local serving.
